subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexacyanomanganate(III)（[Mn(CN)₆]³⁻）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Square pyramidal
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Mn (group 7) 7 e; 6 × CN (X) 6 e; the 3− charge adds 3 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −6 in all and the complex has a 3− charge, so the metal is Mn(III), d⁴; d⁴ + 12 e from the ligands = 16 e.
